name: Bedding The Boss
source:
Bryce Broski has been Duncan Danaka's loyal assistant for two years, trying (and failing) to keep things professional. But one stormy night, one hotel room, and one very big bed later... all bets are off. 

Will Bryce finally get the chance to bed the boss - or win something even better?

[From [url=https://hashiespicy.itch.io/beddingtheboss]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
布莱斯·布罗斯基 (Bryce Broski) 两年来一直是邓肯·达纳卡 (Duncan Danaka) 的忠实助手，试图（但未能）保持事情的专业性。但在一个风雨交加的夜晚，一间酒店房间，以及一张很大的床之后……所有的赌注都落空了。

布莱斯最终能否有机会和老板上床——或者赢得更好的东西？

[来自[url=https://hashiespicy.itch.io/beddingtheboss]itch.io[/url]]
